message: This computed returns a new object with the same primitive contents when its source is replaced, so a downstream identity consumer repeats work
help: Equal-content replacement at 9:16 still allocates a new result; the consumer at 6:7 reruns on the new identity. Vue 3.4+ `computed` getters receive the previous value — finish every reactive read, then reuse that identity when Object.is-equal primitive contents match. Keep a fresh identity when the consumer needs every allocation.

recommendation.import_example: computed((previous) => { const next = /* projection */; return same(previous, next) ? previous : next })
